newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: DIARY-Australia initial public offerings - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: DIARY-Australia initial public offerings - Aug 4.

text.p: The companies listed have made application for admission to the official list of the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) and have been allocated a provisional ASX code. The ASX advises that allocation of a code does not imply that the company's application will be approved. Listing dates are expected listing dates only and are subject to change.
